name: Pioneer Technical Institute
vision: To empower the youths to succeed in the world of work
mission: To empower the youth to succeed in the world of work through a dynamic business, technical and vocational education and training program, thereby cultivating and energizing the spirit of self-enterprise.
address: Iganga Town, Kaliro Road, Nkono 1 zone, about 300m from Kaliro Road Market. P.O. Box 643, Iganga
accreditation: Registered by the Ministry of Education and Sports (PSS/P/34). UBTEB examination center for Technical (UBT125) and Business (UBB093). Also MAC127 for the Directorate of Industrial Training (MOES). A member of UGAPRIV.
